youtube_title: ₹20 Water Sold for ₹100? Is That Legal? #Shorts
youtube_description:
A packed product can't be sold above its printed MRP in India, not even at airports, malls or cinemas. And since 1 January 2018 the same packed product can't carry two different MRPs (dual MRP banned). A sit-down restaurant serving you at the table is a different case. Overcharged? Ask for a bill and complain to the National Consumer Helpline (1915).
Source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (amended 2017; in force 1 Jan 2018).
